# Fetch all pending payment requests using pagination
access_token = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ2ZW5tbytqb3NlaGFyckBnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODcxNzkyNzh9.v_U39okeIqvZJ_TQR-UlxGUVfylGBIoMUJBsDWgP0nc"
all_pending = []
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status="pending", page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_pending.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total pending requests fetched: {len(all_pending)}")
# Print all pending requests for inspection
for req in all_pending:
    print(req)
